items.q: And his sister used to come up to the club -- Shirley Heller

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Pittsburgh -- Jackie Heller -- who had a radio show. And his sister used to come up to the club -- Shirley Heller -- and she said that she was going to send a letter to Mills, because there was some relationship there. And if I ever go to New York, go to Mills and ask for Mr. Pincus. I still haven't found out who Mr. Pincus was.
This is the publishing house Mills?
